facts.text: The Pirate Promise transfer program provides participating North Carolina community college students guaranteed admission to ECU upon completing an approved associate degree.

sources.title: Home | Pirate Promise | ECU
sources.quote: Guaranteed admission to ECU with a completed associate degree (view the list of approved associate degrees)

sources.title: Home | Pirate Promise | ECU
sources.quote: This transfer program is for students who are in their first year of coursework at their community college to attend special events, receive advising assistance, and support before they apply to ECU.
